# Authlane documentation

> Authlane is the connection and tool control plane for SaaS applications.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://authlane.io/docs): Authlane is the connection and tool control plane for SaaS applications
- [Quickstart](https://authlane.io/docs/quickstart): Connect a user and give an AI model their tools without proxying provider traffic
- [OAuth Setup](https://authlane.io/docs/guides/oauth-setup): Configure provider applications and hosted connection flows
- [Self-Hosting Guide](https://authlane.io/docs/guides/self-hosting): Run the hardened Authlane control plane
- [Custom Integrations](https://authlane.io/docs/guides/custom-integrations): Add tool definitions and a direct-execution adapter
- [Security](https://authlane.io/docs/guides/security): Authlane trust boundaries and deployment requirements
- [Security Operations](https://authlane.io/docs/guides/security-operations): Production launch, key rotation, and incident response
- [Webhooks](https://authlane.io/docs/guides/webhooks): Receive signed connection lifecycle events
- [TypeScript SDK](https://authlane.io/docs/sdk/typescript): Server-side, user-scoped access to Authlane capabilities and local AI tools
- [React Embed](https://authlane.io/docs/sdk/react): Embed the hosted connect UI with a short-lived URL
- [Python SDK](https://authlane.io/docs/sdk/python): Use Authlane from Python with non-throwing results and user-scoped tools
- [Framework adapters](https://authlane.io/docs/sdk/frameworks): Give one external user’s connected tools to the AI framework running in your SaaS
- [API Reference](https://authlane.io/docs/api-reference/introduction): Authlane control-plane endpoints
- [Authentication](https://authlane.io/docs/api-reference/authentication): Scoped SaaS keys and short-lived browser sessions
- [List services](https://authlane.io/docs/api-reference/services/list-services): Return services enabled for the authenticated tenant
- [List connection statuses](https://authlane.io/docs/api-reference/connections/list-connections): Return an effective connection status for every enabled tenant service
- [Get capabilities](https://authlane.io/docs/api-reference/connections/capabilities): Return statuses and MCP/OpenAI definitions in one hot-read snapshot
- [Issue a credential lease](https://authlane.io/docs/api-reference/connections/create-credential-lease): Issue audited access-only credential material to a trusted server-side caller
- [Create connect session](https://authlane.io/docs/api-reference/connections/create-connect-session): Create a short-lived browser handoff bound to one user, service allowlist, and exact HTTPS origin
- [Authorize a service](https://authlane.io/docs/api-reference/oauth/authorize): Start PKCE OAuth from a valid connect session in the hosted connect UI
- [OAuth callback](https://authlane.io/docs/api-reference/oauth/callback): Validate OAuth state and PKCE, store encrypted credentials, and return to the hosted connect UI
- [List tools](https://authlane.io/docs/api-reference/tools/list-tools): Return MCP tools or OpenAI functions for currently usable connections
- [GitHub](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/github): Use the local GitHub adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Linear](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/linear): Use the local Linear adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Jira](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/jira): Use the local Jira adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Sentry](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/sentry): Use the local Sentry adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Slack](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/slack): Use the local Slack adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Discord](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/discord): Use the local Discord adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Gmail](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/gmail): Use the local Gmail adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Notion](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/notion): Use the local Notion adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Google Drive](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/google-drive): Use the local Google Drive adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Google Calendar](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/google-calendar): Use the local Google Calendar adapter with Authlane credentials
- [HubSpot](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/hubspot): Use the local HubSpot adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Salesforce](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/salesforce): Use the local Salesforce adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Pipedrive](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/pipedrive): Use the local Pipedrive adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Stripe](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/stripe): Use the local Stripe adapter with Authlane credentials
- [Airtable](https://authlane.io/docs/integrations/airtable): Use the local Airtable adapter with Authlane credentials
